Yarrow Glen Health & Rehabilitation Center - Resident: VANDENBERG, WILHELMINA R. - MR# YG-104417

ADMISSION PACKET - FACE SHEET
Section	Details
Resident	Wilhelmina R. Vandenberg (goes by "Billie")
Date of birth	August 2, 1928 (age 97)
Admitted	11/03/2025 at 14:20 from Underhill Regional Medical Center
Room	214-B, East Wing
SSN	362-21-8792
Medicare (MBI)	4TK8-YE2-MH61, Part A and Part B effective 08-01-1993
Iowa Medicaid	State ID 4418207C - application pending, filed 10/29/2025
Supplement	Sablewood Mutual Life Insurance Company, policy SML-MS-7741902
Long-term care policy	Sablewood LTC-0092-55817, daily benefit $140, 100-day elimination
Marital status	Widowed March 1998; husband Cornelius Vandenberg
Religion	Christian Reformed; member of Fourth Street Reformed Church
Language	English; Dutch was her first language
Veteran status	Widow of a U.S. Army veteran of the Korean War; VA Aid and Attendance claim C 24 417 882
Code status	Do-not-resuscitate; IPOST on chart signed 10/31/2025

Responsible parties
Contact	Relationship	Phone
Lorraine Ochoa	Daughter; durable POA for finances and health care	563-555-0142 cell, (563) 555-0108 home
Gerrit Vandenberg	Son, Tucson, AZ	520.555.0171
Dr. Mirabel Ochoa	Granddaughter	mirabel.ochoa@mailbox.example

Lorraine lives at 1182 Alpine Street, Dubuque, IA 52001, email lorraine.ochoa52@mailbox.example. Statements go to her. Gerrit asked for a copy of anything financial; Lorraine has not agreed, so do NOT send without her written OK. The granddaughter is the only physician in the family and may call for clinical updates; Mrs. Ochoa signed the release for her on 11/03.
Physicians and pharmacy
Attending: Dr. Anselm Bjorklund, NPI 1528830417, office 563-555-0190, fax 563-555-0191
Cardiology: Farida Haidari, MD, NPI 1902277184. Pacemaker checks every 6 months; last 9/16/25.
Audiology: Driftwood Audiology, 563-555-0115
Pharmacy: Orchard Hill Long-Term Care Pharmacy, account OH-22-0871; Medicare Part D ID PDP 7 0041 882 19
Hospital course and diagnoses
Mrs. Vandenberg was hospitalized 10/22/2025 after a fall at home at 640 Rhomberg Avenue with a right intertrochanteric hip fracture, repaired on 10/23. Hospital MRN URMC 00-58-4417. Discharge summary by the hospitalist lists (ICD-10 codes on the transfer form):
Atrial fibrillation, on apixaban 2.5 mg BID
Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction; furosemide 20 mg daily, potassium chloride 10 mEq
Chronic kidney disease, stage 3b; last creatinine 1.4 mg/dL on 11/01
Moderate dementia, Alzheimer's type; BIMS 9 of 15 on admission; donepezil 10 mg QHS
Macular degeneration, left eye worse
Bilateral hearing loss
Depression after her sister's death in 2023; sertraline 25 mg
Stage 2 pressure injury, sacrum, present on admission, 2.4 cm
Allergies: penicillin (hives); sulfa; shellfish. Diet: 2-gram sodium, mechanical soft. Weight 132 lb. Vitals on arrival 142/78, pulse 64, temp 97.9, sat 94% on room air. Braden score 15. Mobility: 2-person assist, non-weight-bearing right leg until ortho follow-up December 4. PASRR Level II screening not required. MDS 3.0 admission assessment due by day 14; Section GG started by therapy.
Medication reconciliation (pharmacy and transfer orders compared 11/03/2025)
Medication	Directions	Rx / note
acetaminophen 650 mg	every 6 hours, scheduled	house stock
oxycodone 2.5 mg	every 6 hours as needed, 12 tablets sent	Rx 7740182 - count on arrival 12
latanoprost, one drop left eye	nightly	Rx 7740185
vitamin D3 2,000 units	daily	family supplied, sent home

The hospital list also showed lorazepam 0.5 mg at bedtime. Dr. Bjorklund stopped it on admission because of the fall. QuantiFERON negative on 10/24; influenza vaccine given 10/02/2025.
Social history (from her daughter, November 5, 2025)
Born in Pella, IA, the youngest of seven; her parents came from Friesland in 1921. She taught fourth grade at Sageville Consolidated School for 31 years and still corrects grammar. Married June 17, 1950. Her husband farmed and later drove a county snowplow; she calls for "Cor" in the late afternoon and it helps to say he is out checking the cattle. She quilted for the church sale every year and knows most of the hymnal by heart. She votes in every election and is a registered Republican; Lorraine will request the absentee ballot. She gave up driving in 2022; her Iowa ID card is 417AB2206. No tobacco, no alcohol.
Her roommate in 214-A, Mrs. Agnes Fitzgerald, is her neighbor of forty years from Rhomberg Avenue; the family asked for this placement. Agnes's daughter has agreed.
Nursing admission note
Arrived by stretcher with Tri-State Medical Transport, run TS-25-110377. Alert, oriented to self only, pleasant, repeating that she needs to get supper on. Pain 3 of 10 at the right hip. Incision clean and dry, staples intact, due out 11/06. High fall risk: bed in low position, alarm on, non-slip socks. Her flip phone (563-555-0184) is kept at the nurses' station; the passcode is 1928. Family was given the East Wing door keypad code, 7731*. After hours, if Lorraine cannot be reached, call her husband Raul Ochoa at 563-555-0133. Long-term care claim opened with the insurer, no. LTC-CLM-250418. Her daughter took the wedding photographs and the blue quilt home to sew name labels on and will bring them back Thursday. - Priscilla Wong, RN, 11/03/2025 16:45
Devices and equipment
Item	Model	Serial
Pacemaker	Medtronic Azure	RNB418827H, implanted May 2019
Hearing aid, left	Phonak	2241X0GK7
Hearing aid, right	Phonak	2241X0GK9
Wheelchair	18 in.	facility tag YG-WC-0338

Both hearing aids go in the locked med cart at night. Billie will take them out and wrap them in tissue, which is how the last pair was lost.
Financial
Private pay daily rate $312.00 (semi-private) until Medicaid is approved; Lorraine paid the first month, $9,360.00, by check #2291 on 11/03/2025. Estimated client participation once approved: $1,847 a month from Social Security ($1,902.00 gross) and the Sablewood annuity ($211.40). Personal needs allowance $50.
Resident trust fund: opened at Dubuque Bluffs Savings Bank, routing 090419494, pooled account 0188-417-2206, sub-account RTF-214B; opening deposit $200.00. Her own checking there (ending 4471) stays open for the Medicaid look-back; balance about eighteen hundred dollars.
The farm ground in Jackson County was deeded to Gerrit in 2021 - flagged for Medicaid's five-year review.
Advance directives and arrangements
Durable power of attorney for health care dated June 9, 2016, prepared under Iowa Code chapter 144D; agent Lorraine Ochoa, alternate G. Vandenberg. Living will on file. Funeral arrangements: Hendry & Sons Funeral Home, prepaid contract PN-0417-88, 563-555-0127; burial next to Cornelius at Linwood Cemetery. Clergy: Pastor Elwood Kapoor, 563-555-0153, visits Tuesdays; she wants to be taken to the chapel service Sundays and does not want care scheduled during it.
Valuables and personal inventory
Item	Quantity	Condition / notes
Wedding band	1	gold band engraved "C.V. to W.R. 6-17-50" - stays on, cannot be removed
Glasses	2	bifocals, name taped inside
Dentures	upper	labeled W. VANDENBERG
Bible	1	Dutch-language family Bible
Cash	-	$40.00 placed in trust, receipt R-11884
Clothing	16 pieces	marked WRV

Resident's rights and signatures
Resident rights under 42 C.F.R. § 483.10 were reviewed with the resident and her representative. Form CMS-802 roster updated.
Responsible party: Lorraine Ochoa, signed 11/03/2025. Witness: Hazel Gupta, CNA.
Admissions Coordinator: Tamsin Hargreaves, thargreaves@yarrowglen.example, 563-555-0160 ext. 204
Director of Nursing: Dwight Pellerin, RN (license IA-RN 118204)
Social Worker: Josefina Romero, LSW - notes that Mr. Vandenberg and his sister are not speaking; calls about money go to Ms. Hargreaves or to Mr. Pellerin, not the floor staff. J. Romero will complete the social history with the family on Nov. 10.
